chapter.title: OF OFFENCES RELATINGTO THE ARMY, [4][NAVY AND AIR FORCE]

heading: Persons subject to certain Acts.
text: No person subject to [1][the Army Act, [2][the Army Act, 1950 (46 of 1950)], the Naval Discipline Act, [3][[4]*** [5][the Indian Navy (Discipline) Act, 1934 (34 of 1934)], [6][the Air Force Act or [7][the Air Force Act, 1950 (45 of 1950)]]], is subject to punishment under this Code for any of the offences defined in this Chapter.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 10 of 1927, s. 2 and the First Sch., for “any Articles of War for the Army of Navy of the Queen, or for any part of such Army or Navy”.
Subs. by Act 3 of 1951, s. 3 and the Sch., for “the Indian Army Act, 1911”.
Ins. by Act 35 of 1934, s. 2 and the Sch.
The words “or that Act as modified by” omitted by the A. O. 1950.
Subs. by Act 14 of 1932, s. 130 and Sch., for “or the Air Force Act”.
Subs. by Act 3 of 1951, s. 3 and the Sch., for “the Indian Air Force Act, 1932”.

notes: Now see the Navy Act, 1957 (62 of 1957).
